short_description: 5 matte vinyl stickers for grown-ups on one kiss-cut sheet: our Maker's Seal, a ball, blocks, a book and our name. Printed when you order.
long_description:
The Play Before Pixels sticker sheet is a set of 5 matte vinyl stickers for grown-ups, printed when you order. Each one peels off the sheet on its own.

On the sheet: our Maker's Seal, with a spinning top in the middle. A bright ball. A tower of three blocks. An open book with a sun on the page. And our name, with a tomato-red dot on the i. These are the simple things our brand is about: toys you can hold, and books you share.

Put them on a laptop, a water bottle, a planner or a notebook. The vinyl is made to handle a splash and a wipe. We test our own sample in water before we list it.

Each sheet is about 5.8 by 8.3 inches. The biggest sticker, the seal, is about 2.6 inches across.

Our print partner prints each sheet when you order and ships it with tracking. Allow a few extra days before it ships.

Please note: these stickers are for grown-ups. They are not a toy. Keep them away from young children, because a peeled sticker is small enough to go in a mouth.

Looking for a small gift? Add it to an order with our logo tee or mug.

faq.a: Five stickers: our Maker's Seal (about 2.6 in), a ball, a tower of three blocks, an open book and our name. Each one peels off on its own.
They are vinyl, made to handle a splash and a wipe. We soak our own sample before we list them. Hand-wash anything they are stuck on; a dishwasher can lift them.
Matte: a soft look with no glare.
No. These stickers are for grown-ups. They are not a toy. Keep them away from young children, because a peeled sticker is small enough to go in a mouth.
Each sheet is printed when you order it, then shipped with tracking. Allow a few extra days before it ships.

faq.q: Can I add it to a tee or mug order?
faq.a: Yes. On our own shop it can be added to the same order, and the shipping then adds very little.

faq.q: Can I send it as a gift?
faq.a: Yes. Enter their address at checkout and it ships straight to them, flat in a rigid mailer. A gift note is added only if our print partner offers one at checkout.

faq.q: What if a sticker arrives damaged?
faq.a: Send a photo through the contact form and our print partner replaces the sheet.

safety.status: UNVERIFIED: no legal review; confirm with a product-safety attorney before launch.
safety.small_parts: Stickers peel into small, thin pieces that a young child could mouth: a choking and small-parts risk. The sheet margin, bullets, FAQ, long description and listing image 4 all say 'Not a toy. Keep away from young children.'
safety.adult_marketing_only: Sold to adults only, for laptops, bottles, planners and notebooks. Never marketed for young children: no child models or hands, no 'kids', 'toddler', 'party favor' or 'reward sticker' words, tags or ads, no classroom or nursery photos, no children's gift guides. Stickers with toy pictures could be read as a children's product under CPSIA (the CPSC weighs marketing, packaging and appeal; UNVERIFIED reading). If that risk is ever judged high, stop selling; children's products stay held until third-party testing and a Children's Product Certificate are funded.
safety.material: Waterproof vinyl with a matte finish; the word 'waterproof' is used only if the sample passes the soak test in QUALITY-STANDARD.md.
safety.cpsia_hold: Kids' sizes, kids' stickers and any toy stay held (CPSIA; legal/LEGAL-LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md row 9).

compliance_notes: No health, medical or outcome claims; no diagnosis or condition wording anywhere in the design, listing, tags, keywords or images (BRAND.md hard rules 1 and 3 and its condition-search section). No slogan on the sheet. The logo stickers use the supplied brand/logo files unaltered: mark-sticker.svg (the sticker version) and lockup-horizontal.svg; the spinning top appears only inside its seal, as the logo guidelines require. The blocks are an illustration stacked as a tower, never a four-square grid or a brand mark (BRAND.md motif list). Trademark: only TM, on the sheet margin. Small-parts and adult-marketing notes are in 'safety' (UNVERIFIED). Adult item only; nothing marketed to children; CPSIA hold on kids' items and toys stays. No inventory: print on demand only. Etsy: production partner listed, 'Designed by', AI tools disclosed; the sheet and images carry no URL or QR. Honest pricing per BRAND.md. 'Waterproof' only after the sample passes. Copyright line on the sheet margin and production sheet: '© 2026 AlphaPlay LLC' / full owner line. Version 1.0 · September 2026. Check every file against the chosen partner's current sticker template before upload.
